# Public development input freeze

The gold-free manifests freeze an independently selected public development sample before any evaluation outputs are consulted. They are not fresh blind or sealed evidence. Raw task inputs remain in ignored run directories. No benchmark prompt or gold is used for synthetic training or calibration.

The pinned public repository provides 231 items; the v1.5 method documents 601 published-open and 904 open items. This sample does not cover the additional 370 published items absent from the checkout, or the judge tier. Method hashes match the observed v1.5.4 reference.

Software tests and preparation passed. Model collection and baseline-versus-pilot results are pending. See [the run guide](../../docs/jevbench-open-development.md) and `validation.json`.
